paragraphs.text: Fatehold is the School of Future History at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios . It is aligned and the counterpart of Lorehold . The founder of the school is Denzilore Fatehold .
Denzilore Fatehold founded Fatehold with three guiding principles:
The future is a cautionary tale and a model for the present.
Predict what can happen, then influence a component of that future to direct the course of history.
Use the power of future knowledge for the betterment of all.

Fatehold mages predict all possible futures, looking for an optimal end state. They then manipulate the present to change the course of history toward that optimal endpoint. Fatehold divination spells target the potential energy within each object to view its possible futures. Their spellcasting, known as fateshaping, requires a great deal of concentration. It manifests as spectral book pages and scrolls. Fatehold predictions and fate-controlling spells have stabilized communities across Echoverse Arcavios .

In fateshaping courses, Fatehold cadets learn to wield divination spells as combat magic. They can create manifestations of the "pages of fate" to attack or defend against foes in the present. Fatehold graduates generally either gravitate toward advisory roles or continue their work in the future archives. Some mages become foreseers, chronologists, strategic prophets, or futurescribes, who chronicle the visions other mages divine.

The Fatehold campus is located at the base of the Theorist's tower , metaphorically and literally forming the foundation of Hexhaven . Fatehold's windows look out at the Eradia as a constant reminder of the future they seek to ensure. Many Fatehold mages confine themselves to archives and divination chambers. Fatehold's research archives and prophecy repository are filled with notes and scrolls detailing prophecies. Records remain there until the event has passed and is no longer a possible future, at which point the record is moved to the Folioplex . The Preopticon amplifies the power of prophecy with mirrors surrounding a circular platform. Newer cadets are not allowed to use the Preopticon, as an unprepared mind cannot survive it.
